watchlist.add_sub: Search your list, coins, funds, the SEC company map and every venue Yahoo quotes.
watchlist.add_placeholder: Ticker or company name — AAPL, novo nordisk, BTC-EUR, IWDA…
watchlist.add_hint: Type at least two characters. Picking a result adds it with its real name — no spelling from memory.
watchlist.add_none: Nothing found. Try the company name, or the exact symbol with its venue suffix (MIPS.ST).
watchlist.add_groups_help: Whatever you pick here is applied to the next symbol you add. Type a new name to start a group.
watchlist.kind_raw: Unknown to every catalog — add it anyway and see what the data pages find
watchlist.list_sub: Feeds Overview, Screener, Earnings and the ticker picker. Every edit saves as you make it.
watchlist.filter_ph: Filter by symbol, name or group…
watchlist.mobile_cap: {n} more in this group — narrow the filter to reach them.
watchlist.col_tags_help: Pick the groups this ticker belongs to, or type a new name to start one. Overview renders a section per group and the search box matches them.
watchlist.col_cost_help: Average buy price per share, in the stock's native currency. Shares + cost make an entry a position for the fallback analytics; an imported ledger still wins.
watchlist.col_actions_help: Open the ticker page, or drop it from the watchlist.
watchlist.group_manage_help: A group is just this tag on its members — renaming it renames it everywhere, dissolving it keeps the tickers.
watchlist.group_delete_help: Removes the group from its members. The tickers stay on the watchlist.
watchlist.how:
- Every edit here writes immediately — the star, the groups, the shares, the removals.
- `Shares` + `Avg cost` make an entry a position for the equal-weight fallback analytics; the real book still comes from imported transactions.
- Alert rules you set on the ticker page are kept when you edit or regroup a holding.
- Crypto goes in as a Yahoo pair symbol — `BTC-USD`, `ETH-EUR` — never a bare coin code, which would collide with a stock ticker. The search does this for you.
- A ticker can sit in several groups, and Overview will show it in each.
